claims.claim_text: 這套系統「超過 18B 參數」、「超過 36 GB 的 bf16 權重」，而每顆 Trillium 只有 32 GB HBM
claims.evidence: Avatar IV, the diffusion stack behind our talking-head videos, runs on more than 18B parameters — The two transformers total more than 36 GB of bf16 weights against 32 GB of HBM per Trillium chip
claims.note: Both 「超過」 renderings preserve the source's "more than"; the 32 GB HBM figure is per-chip in the source and per-chip in the lede.

claims.claim_text: 解法是 FSDP 權重切分疊上 Ulysses sequence parallelism 共用同一個 mesh，再讓 Trillium 的 SparseCore 非同步扛下每一層的 weight gather
claims.evidence: Weights are FSDP-sharded and sequences Ulysses-sharded across the same eight-chip mesh — Trillium's SparseCore, a co-processor that runs alongside the main core, carries each layer's weight gathers asynchronously
claims.note: "same eight-chip mesh" supports 「共用同一個 mesh」; "asynchronously" supports 「非同步」.

claims.claim_text: sparse attention 的 block 限制從 128 的倍數放寬到 16 的倍數
claims.evidence: We relaxed the kernel's block-size constraint from multiples of 128 down to multiples of 16
claims.note: Direction and both multiples match exactly.

claims.claim_text: softmax 的 running maximum 換成用 Cauchy-Schwarz 算出的上界（適用於 98% 到 99% 的 head）
claims.evidence: We replaced the running max with a precomputed upper bound. By the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality... — On our production data, 98–99% of heads qualify
claims.note: The lede's 「適用於」 matches "qualify"; the source scopes the figure to its production data and the lede does not over-generalise it into a universal rate.

claims.claim_text: 最後比第一個可運作版本快 1.86 倍
claims.evidence: made it 1.86× faster than our first working version
claims.note: Baseline ("first working version") is stated in both, so the multiplier is not floating free of its comparand.

claims.claim_text: 這個專案改掉 AMD Family 16h 的 MCT/DCT 設定，讓同一個 DRAM cell 能被另一組位址別名讀到，於是 PSP 的私有 carveout、SMRAM 裡的 SMM handler、C6 存下的 CPU 暫存器與等著重載的 microcode patch 都跟著露出來
claims.evidence: AMD Family 16h CPUs — the exploit operates at the MCT/DCT level, modifying physical address translations before they reach actual DRAM — PSP private DRAM carveouts; SMRAM/SMM handler entry vectors at `SMBASE + 0x8000`; C6 idle-state CPU register saves (16 KiB per core); Microcode patch RAM stored in DRAM at `CC6_BASE + 0x1800`
claims.note: All four exposed regions named in the lede appear in the README's own list.

claims.claim_text: 作法是丟 sentinel 值觀察它們在哪裡浮出來，把 (target, alias) 配對餵給 Z3，用 GF(2) 上的線性代數解出未知的轉換矩陣
claims.evidence: drop[ping] some sentinel value like `0xdeadc0de` into a random address in memory, flip back to the coherent view, and sweep memory for where the sentinel resurfaces — pass it to z3, and it solves the translation matrix needed to convert between the two views — the DRAM controller's address transform is a GF(2) linear map
claims.note: Z3, GF(2), the sentinel sweep and the translation matrix are all the source's own terms.

claims.claim_text: 作者挑上 Family 16h 的理由是「最後一個公開文件記載了 DRAM controller 翻譯暫存器的世代，而且文件顯示它們無法被鎖住」
claims.evidence: AMD Family 16h CPUs, the last generation whose datasheets document the DRAM controller's translation registers — and show that they can't be locked. 17h and beyond simply leave this information out.
claims.note: Quoted string is a faithful zh-tw rendering of the source sentence, including both halves. No strength added.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 在 2026 上半年擋下 2,320 萬次 network-layer DDoS 攻擊與 29.64 兆次 HTTP DDoS 請求
claims.evidence: Cloudflare has already mitigated 23.2 million network-layer and 29.64 trillion HTTP DDoS requests.
claims.note: 2,320 萬 = 23.2 million and 29.64 兆 = 29.64 trillion; the H1-2026 window matches the report's own scope.

claims.claim_text: 平均大約每小時 5,343 次
claims.evidence: That works out to approximately 5,343 network-layer DDoS attacks per hour, or about 128,000 per day.
claims.note: 「大約」 mirrors "approximately"; the lede correctly attaches the rate to network-layer attacks.

claims.claim_text: DNS flood 佔 network-layer 攻擊的比例季增從 25.7% 升到 40.0%，CLDAP flood 季增 580% 成為 Q2 第三大向量
claims.evidence: DNS Floods alone climbing from 25.7% to 40.0% of network-layer attacks quarter-over-quarter. CLDAP Floods surged +580% quarter-over-quarter to become the #3 vector in Q2.
claims.note: Both percentages, the QoQ framing, the +580% and the #3-in-Q2 ranking are stated in one source sentence pair.

claims.claim_text: 超過 1 Tbps 的攻擊從 Q1 到 Q2 增加 519%，整個上半年合計 935 次
claims.evidence: Cloudflare mitigated a combined 935 network-layer DDoS attacks exceeding 1 Tbps in the first half of 2026 and a +519% quarter-over-quarter surge between Q1 and Q2.
claims.note: The lede keeps 935 as a half-year total and 519% as the Q1→Q2 delta — the two are not conflated.

claims.claim_text: 重心明顯從 botnet flood 移向 reflection 與 amplification
claims.evidence: The attack-vector center of gravity shifted from botnet floods to reflection and amplification.
claims.note: This is the report's own framing sentence, not the post's synthesis.

claims.claim_text: 主張訓練脈絡裡「充足的相關資訊會降低把該資訊寫進參數的誘因，因而提高對脈絡的依賴」
claims.evidence: abundant relevant information in the training context can reduce the incentive to encode that information parametrically, thereby increasing reliance on context
claims.note: Source uses "can reduce"; the lede frames the whole quote under 「主張」, preserving the claim-not-fact framing.

claims.claim_text: 加大 context window 對語言模型、自然語言理解與 closed-book MCQA 的幫助只到一個中間最佳點，之後表現持續下滑
claims.evidence: In pretraining with long documents, increasing the context window improves language modeling, natural language understanding, and closed-book MCQA only up to an intermediate optimum, after which performance consistently declines.
claims.note: All three task families and the shape of the finding are stated in the abstract.

claims.claim_text: 機制面的線索是梯度壓力從常被連結到參數知識的 feed-forward network 移向 attention 模組，作者再以 causal intervention 確認這個位移確實提高了推論時對脈絡的依賴
claims.evidence: training with informative context shifts gradient pressure from feed-forward networks, often linked to parametric knowledge, toward attention modules — causal interventions show that this shift increases reliance on context during inference.
claims.note: The parenthetical 「常被連結到參數知識」 is the source's own wording, not an added gloss.

claims.claim_text: Fil-C 用 capability、執行期檢查與並行 GC 重新編譯 C 與 C++，「記憶體安全違規會 panic 而不是變成 exploit」
claims.evidence: recompiles C and C++ with capabilities, runtime checks, and a concurrent garbage collector. — Memory-safety violations panic instead of becoming exploits.
claims.note: Quoted string matches the source sentence one-for-one; the three mechanisms are listed in source order.

claims.claim_text: 今天的 extern "C" 對上的是 Fil-C 口中的 Yolo-C ABI，而 Fil-C「與 C 源碼相容，但刻意不做 ABI 相容」，還要求整個程式與相依都走它的 ABI
claims.evidence: today's `extern "C"` ... speaks the ABI Fil-C calls Yolo-C — source-compatible with C but intentionally not ABI-compatible — requires the whole program and its dependencies to use its ABI
claims.note: "intentionally" is rendered 「刻意」 — the deliberateness is the source's.

claims.claim_text: 橋接一旦成立，繼續用 C 才要付效能代價，把熱點改寫成 Rust 反而是拿掉檢查的那條路
claims.evidence: Rewriting performance-critical sections in Rust eliminates these checks, making Rust the fast path and C the safe-but-slow compatibility layer—inverting today's incentives where C remains the cheap, unsafe default.
claims.note: The incentive-inversion argument is the cited author's own thesis, and the lede attributes it rather than asserting it as measured fact.

claims.claim_text: 作者的說法是「雙向綁定在 Rust 裡行不通（在其他語言裡也只是勉強可用）」
claims.evidence: two-way bindings don't work in Rust (and barely work in other languages)
claims.note: Parenthetical preserved; lede carries visible attribution 「作者的說法是」.

claims.claim_text: 「它至少有一半的問題來自把雙向綁定烤進 API」
claims.evidence: at least half its problems come from baking two-way bindings into its API
claims.note: 「至少」 matches "at least".

claims.claim_text: 框架本身大約 30 個 trait 與大約 70 個 View 實作
claims.evidence: approximately 30 traits (187 in `xilem_web`), with roughly 70 `View` implementations across codebase
claims.note: Checked adversarially: the source's parenthetical 187 belongs to xilem_web, and the lede's 「框架本身」 correctly scopes the ~30 figure to the core framework rather than silently reporting the larger number or merging the two.

claims.claim_text: 具體症狀是 Lens、MapMessage、Memoize 這些高階元件產出無法見人的公開簽章，以及 fork、run_once、worker 這類帶副作用的 view 破壞了反應式模型的前提
claims.evidence: Higher-order components like `Lens`, `MapMessage`, and `Memoize` have unacceptable public signatures. ... Views designed to trigger side-effects on first build—including `fork`, `run_once`, and `worker`—violate the reactive model's principle
claims.note: All six named APIs appear in the source in the roles the lede assigns them.

claims.claim_text: 作者開的處方是改用型別抹除的 Component、把副作用移出 view rebuild，並砍掉 virtual scrolling、environment context 與核心對 Tokio 的相依
claims.evidence: Replace generics with a type-erased `Component` type — Relocate side-effects from view rebuilding into explicit callbacks — Eliminate features like virtual scrolling, environment contexts, and the Tokio dependency
claims.note: All three prescriptions present; framed as recommendation in both source and lede.

claims.claim_text: Microsoft.Extensions.AI 10.9.0 加進四個實驗性型別——RoutingChatClient、SemanticRoutingChatClient、FailoverChatClient 與 OrderedFailoverChatClient，全部掛在診斷代號 MEAI001 底下
claims.evidence: Microsoft.Extensions.AI version 10.9.0 introduced four experimental routing types: `RoutingChatClient`, `SemanticRoutingChatClient`, `FailoverChatClient`, and `OrderedFailoverChatClient`. The diagnostic ID is `MEAI001`.
claims.note: Version string, count, all four type names and the diagnostic ID match exactly.

claims.claim_text: callback 收到一個帶著訊息與 ChatOptions 副本的 RoutingContext，而「呼叫端自己的 options 物件永遠不會交給任何 client」
claims.evidence: Each invocation creates a `RoutingContext` containing the request messages and a duplicate of `ChatOptions`. Critically: "the caller's own options object is never handed to a client, and changes they make after the call starts aren't observed."
claims.note: Checked adversarially: source reads "never handed to a client", post reads 「永遠不會交給任何 client」. Under negation the scope is equivalent, so this is trivial reformatting rather than strengthening.

claims.claim_text: 語意路由用 embedding 相似度比對範例語句，官方的建議是「平均數個匹配比賭最接近的那一個更穩」；失效轉移只在輸出尚未送出前重選，目前不支援 model cascading、ensemble 與 hedging
claims.evidence: embedding the final user message and comparing it against cached embeddings of example utterances per client — "averaging several matches is steadier than betting on the single closest one" — only before streaming output reaches the caller — model cascading, ensemble routing, and hedging remain outside `RoutingChatClient`'s scope
claims.note: 「更穩」 matches "is steadier"; the unsupported-pattern list matches the source's three items.

claims.claim_text: NuGet.org 從 2026 年 8 月 17 日起把新 API key 的效期上限從 365 天縮到 30 天，8 月 17 日以前建立的金鑰則在 11 月 1 日全數到期
claims.evidence: Old maximum: 365 days; New maximum: 30 days; Cutover date: August 17, 2026; Expiry date for pre-cutover keys: November 1, 2026
claims.note: Both lifetimes and both dates match, and the lede keeps the correct pairing.

claims.claim_text: 「一個 OIDC 工作流程把簽章過的短期身分 token 交給發布流程，NuGet.org 依套件擁有者設定的政策驗證那個 token，再為該次發布操作簽發一把臨時 API key」，目前支援 GitHub Actions 與 GitLab
claims.evidence: An OIDC workflow presents a signed, short-lived identity token to the publishing pipeline. NuGet.org validates that token against a policy configured by the package owner and issues a temporary API key for that publishing operation.
claims.note: Three-step quote matches clause by clause. GitHub Actions and GitLab are the two providers named in the source.

claims.claim_text: 攻擊者用偷來的憑證發布的惡意套件在被移除前的 36 分鐘內被觸發了 6000 次
claims.evidence: The package was activated 6000 times in 36 minutes, before it was taken down.
claims.note: Both figures and the before-takedown ordering match the source sentence exactly.

claims.claim_text: Google 開源了 Credentio，一套處理 C2PA Content Credentials 的 C++ 函式庫，目前聚焦在驗證這一側：trust list 整合、manifest 解析與逐項的 verdict 報告
claims.evidence: an open-source C++ library designed for working with Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) Content Credentials — "Trust List Integration," "Comprehensive Parsing" of manifests and signatures, and "Detailed Verdict Reports"
claims.note: The three capabilities named in the lede map onto the source's three feature headings.

claims.claim_text: 「Credentio 提供的 API 設計成完全在開發者的應用程式內本機執行」，因此「不需要把媒體檔送到雲端伺服器驗證」
claims.evidence: Credentio provides an API designed to run completely locally within developer applications. This removes the need to send media files to cloud servers for validation.
claims.note: Both quoted strings are faithful renderings of two consecutive source sentences.

claims.claim_text: 官方說同一套引擎已經撐起「將近 40 個符合 C2PA 規範的 Google 產品」並擴展到數百億個生成資產，不過公告只說記憶體佔用比其他方案小，沒有給出可比對的數字
claims.evidence: nearly 40 different conformant C2PA-enabled Google products — tens of billions of generated assets — "uses significantly less memory than other solutions when validating large files" with no specific comparative numbers or benchmarks
claims.note: 「數百億」 correctly renders "tens of billions". The lede's closing observation that no comparable memory figure is given is itself accurate against the fetched text.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 的量測顯示全食帶上的網路流量下降「大約 15% 到 30%」，偏食程度淺的地區則幾乎沒有變化
claims.evidence: regions along the path of totality saw traffic fall by roughly 15% to 30%, whereas areas experiencing only a shallow partial eclipse dipped far less or not at all.
claims.note: 「大約」 preserves "roughly" — the range is not hardened into a point estimate.

claims.claim_text: 基準線的取法是「前三個星期三的中位數，依時段逐格對齊」
claims.evidence: the median of the three previous Wednesdays, matched slot-by-slot on time-of-day.
claims.note: Both halves present: the median-of-three-Wednesdays baseline and the slot-by-slot alignment.

claims.claim_text: 日食帶從阿拉斯加時間 15:35 UTC 起掃過大西洋北緣
claims.evidence: changes in traffic beginning in Alaska around 15:35 UTC, where the eclipse began its pathway.
claims.note: 15:35 UTC and the Alaska origin are both in the source; the lede's 「起」 preserves it as the start of the path.

claims.claim_text: 冰島、西班牙與葡萄牙的跌幅最深，挪威與瑞典反而略高於基準，丹麥的變化最小
claims.evidence: Iceland, Spain, and Portugal experienced the most dramatic drops in traffic. — Norway and Sweden actually saw slight traffic increases above baseline, while Denmark recorded the least overall change.
claims.note: All six countries and the direction of each effect match the source, including the counter-intuitive Norway/Sweden increase.

claims.claim_text: 恢復通常「在最大遮蔽後幾分鐘內」就發生
claims.evidence: rebounds as the sun reappears, typically within minutes of maximum coverage as people return to their screens.
claims.note: 「通常」 matches "typically".
